report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Kavya Reddy | Age: 59
Body Temperature at Scene: 20.5°C | Ambient Temperature: 22.5°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 15.8 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Abdominal: Blunt force trauma with splenic laceration [MODERATE]
  2. Thoracic: Multiple rib fractures with internal hemorrhage [SEVERE]
  3. Neck: Compression marks consistent with ligature strangulation [SEVERE]
  4. Lower Limb: Multiple contusions consistent with assault [MILD]
  5. Upper Limb: Defensive bruising on forearms [MODERATE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): Benzodiazepines, Chloroform, Opiates

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed posterior — no repositioning detected.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
